candidates.change_summary: Remove the ownership check so anyone can call withdraw.
Remove the transfer so withdraw sends no funds.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may withdraw.
Send the withdrawn balance to the caller instead of the owner.

Replaced msg.sender == Owner with adr == Owner in the require check, changing who can successfully call Command.
Sent value 0 instead of msg.value in the call, so no ETH is forwarded to adr.
Removed the adr.call statement so Command no longer forwards value/data to adr.
